title: asn2wrs: Update to not initialize static proto values

notes.body:
added 1501 commits
  • 66357ac2...8fc6ea32 - 1499 commits from branch wireshark:master
  • a23418b4 - Initialize static proto values to 0
  • 90e49812 - asn2wrs: Update to not initialize static proto values
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/11182/diffs?diff_id=833849123&start_sha=66357ac2f2e699b329ec40e25d5ee2ba84758941)

ℹ️ This merge request has more than one commit. Please squash any trivial ones:
  ~~~
  90e49812 asn2wrs: Update to not initialize static proto values
a23418b4 Initialize static proto values to 0

Is the long-term goal to eliminate *all* initialization of protocol, hf_, and ei_ values in Wireshark (unless they are, for example, contained in a structure other members of which are initialized)?
